description.summary: compositor-drawn shape, elevation, motion and gestures

protocol.description:
The client commits pixels once; the compositor draws corners and shadow from design tokens, runs animations, and runs finger-driven gestures with their inertia. Curves are the shared libdesk-motion curves, so a client can compute any in-between value itself from a started event.
Pointer and touch input follow the current animated transform and are clipped to the current clip rect.
Only unsandboxed clients see this global.

request.name: get_surface
request.description: One dsk_surface_v1 per wl_surface; a second one is a protocol error.

request.name: get_tracker

description.summary: a compositor-owned gesture on a surface

request.description: The compositor receives the gesture input inside the tracker's region, moves the tracker position, and on release runs inertia and a spring to a snap point. Bindings map the position to properties of any dsk_surface_v1 of this client.

interface.name: dsk_surface_v1

description.summary: shape, elevation and animations of one surface

interface.description: All requests are double-buffered and apply on the next wl_surface.commit, so new pixels and the motion that shows them start in the same frame.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Running animations stop at their current value.

entry.name: invalid_value
entry.summary: an enum argument is out of range

entry.name: translate
entry.summary: a = x, b = y, logical px

entry.name: scale
entry.summary: a = uniform scale about the surface center

entry.name: clip
entry.summary: a, b, c, d = x, y, width, height, surface-local px

enum.name: curve
enum.description: Springs use the tokens spring.* (damping is the ratio to critical). ease_* are ease-out cubic over the tokens motion.* duration.

entry.name: cancelled
entry.summary: set, unmap, or a tracker took over

request.name: set
request.description: Stops a running animation on it (done, reason cancelled). Unused components are ignored.

request.name: animate

description.summary: animate a property from its current value

request.description: Starts from the current presented value. On a running animation it retargets and keeps the velocity (spring curves). The serial comes back in started and done. With the reduce_motion appearance setting, every property but opacity moves at once.

event.name: started
event.description: time is CLOCK_MONOTONIC ms of that frame; with the curve and the start value the client can compute every later value itself.

request.name: set_clip_from

description.summary: clip to a rect of another surface

request.description: Sets clip, as a set of clip would, to a rect given in the source surface's local coordinates. The source position is read now, this surface's position at the commit that applies the request, so it works on the commit that maps this surface. Neither surface's own translate or scale counts. An island grows into its sheet by this request followed by an animate of clip. The source must be a mapped layer surface and this surface a layer surface; otherwise the request does nothing and clip_mapped is not sent.

event.name: clip_mapped
event.description: Sent at once for each set_clip_from that took effect, with the rect in this surface's coordinates, so the client can animate back to it.

interface.name: dsk_tracker_v1
interface.description: A one-dimensional position the compositor drives from input, after the Windows InteractionTracker model: interacting, then inertia, then idle. Configuration is double-buffered on the tracker's wl_surface commit.

entry.name: invalid_value
entry.summary: an enum argument is out of range

request.name: set_source

description.summary: where and how the gesture starts

request.description: region is surface-local; null means the whole surface. fingers is the touchpad finger count of a swipe (vertical, horizontal) or a pinch. fingers 0 is a left-button pointer drag or a one-finger touch drag: the client gets the press, and once the drag moves 8 px along the axis the compositor claims it and the client gets a pointer leave or touch cancel. A pinch from scale 1 to 2 moves the whole range.

description.summary: position limits; past them the motion rubber-bands
a rest position; inertia ends on the snap the throw projects to

request.name: bind

description.summary: drive a property from the position

request.description: Maps position p0..p1 linearly to value v0..v1 on one component (0 = a .. 3 = d) of a property of target. Values clamp outside the range.

request.name: move_to

description.summary: drive the position without input, for example a click that opens

request.description: Springs from the current position and velocity. Curve none, or the reduce_motion appearance setting, moves at once and sends idle. A running gesture is not interrupted.

request.name: watch
request.description: A position event follows every presented frame that moved it. Use it only for client pixels that must follow the finger, for example the bar's workspace indicator during a workspace swipe. Animations need no per-frame events: curves are deterministic from started.

description.summary: released; the position will rest at target
